answer: Capacity-Ledger Identity Cap. Each agent identity gets a ledger slot whose task throughput is capped by a public resource ledge: shared compute, storage, and message quota allocated per slot. Cloning an identity yields no extra capacity because the allocator deduplicates by resource vine—new slots attach to the same underlying allocation. Any clone attempting to exceed the cap triggers throttling and forfeits its jade score, a reputation balance that decays with each flagged duplicate.
